title: T-50 (2026-11-13): players buy buildings from each other - the game's own buy box on another player's deed becomes a hub offer (Kind=building) to that owner; Accept moves the deed (host ledger + both games), the money once each way as the game's own building bought/sold transactions, the rent income to the buyer; a seller who keeps renting pays the buyer the game's own daily rent once per day; an offline owner is refused up front; a seller killed before applying finishes after rejoin; a Hamptons house is refused; fold: escrow-first legs, crash after applied legs (seller and buyer, host sells and host buys), retire only once saved; fold 2: a refund when the seller never releases (deadline lever), a lost money confirmation, the host killed after its own money leg (exact balances across relaunch), a buyer left at exactly $0
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1; Murray Hill special rival ju1yVbREcE2B5ymg6q5tyA== owns for-rent buildings). Dev build with the T-50 levers (bldoffer, hubanswer, deedstate, xferstate, xferhold, txlines, bldrent, deedset, bldhampton, moneymark, moneydelta - BuildingSale.cs) and T-33's rivalrent buy / realbuy. The client gets +9M (spend lever) for two real buys and stays under 16,777,216 (float money holds only even numbers above it); the host pays 250,000 + 300,000 from its own money. Amounts are proven exact by the tagged transaction lines (txlines tagged=1 taggedsum=...). The scenario SAVES (save lever) into the fixture, which the rig resets. T6 needs the Hamptons DLC on the rig (asserted). Fold 2 levers: xferdrop (one confirmation lost), xferdeadline (DEV override of RefundAfterDays).
